::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Jan 22 1896  
**Manuscript:** Copy outletter book, Hampshire Record Office 70M92W/60/214
:::

Dear Madam

The insurances existing are as follow

£360 in premises occupied by Hicks.
£1700 on Rising Sun & various cottages
£300 on House occupied by Mimksn [?]

I do not appear to have any insurances on your <u>own</u> House or the contents  Shall I get you a Policy for it & contents or only for £200 on Contents

I am yours faithy
[Chas Wooldridge](people/person_2094.qmd)

Miss Yonge

£200 seems to me rather a small sum
